delete.title: Delete startup app {name}?
delete.registry: “{entry}” will be removed from {location}. This cannot be undone; the program itself is kept.
delete.file: “{entry}” in {location} will be moved to the Recycle Bin; the program itself is kept.

error.accessDenied: Access denied: startup app {name} could not be deleted. Items for all users need Argus running as administrator; other items may be protected by file or registry permissions.
error.refused: Startup app {name} cannot be deleted. Startup tasks of app packages can only be disabled.

missing.label: File missing
missing.title: The program this command points to no longer exists; this item can be disabled

blocked.managed: This app does not allow manual changes to this startup task.
blocked.unavailable: The state of this startup task could not be read. No changes were made.

note: Disabled items can be enabled again. Changing an all-users startup item requires administrator rights.
